title: Committee note
original:
# Committee note

In light of the fact that the committee had not yet reached a final determination on the matter, it was decided by the members that they would postpone the vote until such time as additional information could be gathered and reviewed in a comprehensive manner.

It is worth noting that several of the participants expressed a degree of concern regarding the timeline, which they felt was perhaps somewhat too aggressive given the current circumstances.

The chair undertook to circulate a revised schedule in advance of the next meeting, which is currently anticipated to take place in the early part of next month.
